answer: The fee is charged through an umber debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the oasis totals, and the timber anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. At 15 units per epoch, sustaining 198 aliases for 13 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the copycat. That is 22 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
